out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Observed multiple screw top plastic water bottles for employees in food prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC discarded the bottles.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: blanched fries at 54F, red pepper bruschetta at 62F in 4DR Continental Prep Cooler (R). Olive and onion focaccia at 74F under prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC contacted technician for cooler service and placed food on ice. Olive and onion focaccia will be on 6hr time control.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): fontina sauce at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS provided PIC with written instructions.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 4DR Continental Prep (R) at 44/54F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Please submit repair invoice to the Health Department within 3 days or take the cooler offline. CORSICA BAR RESTON (Inspection Date: 09/23/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in a counter top steam well: mushroom stock (111f), beef sauce (125f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REHEAT THE FOOD ON THE STOVE TO 165f. MUSHROOM STOCK WAS OBSERVED AT 211f. BEEF SAUCE WAS OBSERVED AT 185F. FOOD WAS PLACED BACK IN THE STEAM WELL.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) on ice at the bar: melon juice (50f). Upon discussion with management, melon juice was taken out 30 minutes prior to inspection
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC PLACED THE MELON JUICE IN A WORKING COOLER TO CHILL TO 41f. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO USE MORE ICE AND KEEP LESS JUICE IN THE BOTTLE FOR FUTURE USE.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved Y splitter on the mop sink
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH INFORMATION FOR AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. ORDER AND INSTALL. SEND EHS PHOTO VERIFICATION. CORSICA BAR RESTON (Inspection Date: 04/10/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed the water filter dripping on the clean drain board of the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. REPAIR WATER FILTER TO PREVENT ANY DRIPPING ONTO CLEAN EQUIPMENT/DISHES

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED TWO DIFFERENT TYPES OF CHICKEN PARTIALLY COOKED STORED IN PREP-TOP UNITS AT THE COOK-LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. EHS DISCUSSED REQUIREMENTS OF NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS WITH THE PIC. THE FACILITY HAS AGREED TO DISCONTINUE THE PROCESS FOR NOW AND UNDERSTANDS WRITTEN PLANS/TEMPERATURE DOCUMENTATION WOULD BE REQUIRED IF THE FACILITY WOULD LIKE TO CONTINUE THIS PROCESS.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item that may be served raw and/or undercooked: OBSERVED BÉARNAISE SAUCE (MADE WITH RAW SHELLED EGGS) WITHOUT CONSUMER ADVISORY ON THE MENU.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PIC ADDED CONSUMER ADVISORY TO THE BÉARNAISE SAUCE DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONSUMER ADVISORY IS ADDED TO ANY APPROPRIATE FOOD ITEMS IN THE FUTURE IF CHANGES ARE MADE TO THE MENU.
